Background

This network started as a 105 KB ONNX model inside a third-party SDK bundled with a mobile merge game. The SDK fed it a player profile (ad watches, session length, logins, currency, board fill, country, device) and the next 63 pieces on offer. One head predicted how many seconds the player would keep playing. The other predicted the chance they would watch an ad. The SDK appears to use those two scores to choose which item a generator drops. Here the architecture is kept, those objectives are thrown out, and both heads are retrained to steer a worm toward food.
